decisions.dock_plan: Meridian from 6:00 to 6:30 PM, Glass Harbor from 6:30 to 7:00 PM
decisions.meridian_entry: Main backstage entrance with two security escorts

commitments.detail: Two security escorts will be provided for Meridian.
Meridian will have exclusive use of the loading dock from 6:00 to 6:30 PM.
Glass Harbor will have exclusive use of the loading dock from 6:30 to 7:00 PM.
Meridian will enter the venue via the main backstage entrance with two security escorts.
A standard buffet will be available for Meridian at 6:30 PM.
Glass Harbor will use the north service corridor for access to the venue.
